accidentJourney.intro: First, we make sure everyone is safe. Then we show you what to preserve and the clearest next step.
accidentJourney.privacy: Your answers are used only to guide you on this page. They are not saved or sent.
accidentJourney.title: Is anyone injured?

injured.title: Safety comes first.
injured.body: Move away from immediate danger only when it is safe. Do not continue documenting until the situation is under control.
injured.emergency: Contact local emergency services and follow the operator’s instructions.

unsure.title: Treat this as a possible injury.
unsure.body: Do not continue down the material-damage path until the situation is clear.
unsure.emergency: Seek immediate professional or emergency assessment.

vehicleSafety.title: Can the vehicle be moved safely?
vehicleSafety.hint: If you have any concern about the wheels, steering, or brakes, do not move it.
vehicleSafety.yes: Yes, it can be moved safely
vehicleSafety.unsure: I am not sure about the vehicle

unsafeVehicle.title: Do not move the vehicle.
unsafeVehicle.body: Stay clear of traffic and use warning signals only when you can do so safely.
unsafeVehicle.emergency: Request local roadside help or contact emergency services.

countries.incidentTitle: In which country did the accident happen?
countries.incidentHint: You confirm this yourself; we do not infer it from language, residence, or location.
countries.registrationHint: This may be different from the country where the accident happened.
countries.counterpartyTitle: Which country is the insurer or other vehicle from?
countries.counterpartyHint: If you do not know, select “I am not sure”.

evidence.title: Preserve the important facts.
evidence.body: When the scene is safe, collect evidence without putting yourself at risk. These are universal steps; legal procedure may differ by country.

items.scene: Photos of the scene, vehicles, damage, and number plates.
items.insurance: Insurance or Green Card details for the parties.
items.context: The date, time, location, and witness details.
items.reference: A police or EAS reference only when applicable and provided.

evidence.diasporaTitle: Away from home? We are with you.
evidence.diasporaBody: The accident country, vehicle registration, and other party stay separate so your route remains clear.
